column4: 0x130-byte object, vtable 00428038, base 0040e5a0; creates candidate lists (capacity 0x1e) at +0x6c/+0x70 and a shared list 00442060
vtable slot 12: appends an object to the candidate list +0x70 (objects under the pointer register themselves; the registering geometric test is not yet located)
vtable slot 11: returns flag bit 10 of +0x68

per frame: for each registered candidate, with left button (mouse buttons byte & 8) calls candidate slot 14 with the cursor's current animation index (the verb), with right button (& 0x10) slot 15, otherwise slot 17 (show hover text); candidates that stopped being under the pointer get slot 18 (clear text) and are dropped

vtable slot 4: reads the mouse position and buttons and the keyboard state array, handles the interface strip scrolling (shifts by 0x280 = one screen width), then positions the cursor object and its +0x74 companion at the mouse position plus the interface camera offset, and flags the held item
renders the scene without the cursor into the display buffer and copies a 213x160 sample (every third pixel of every third row) to +0x128: a save-game thumbnail (hypothesis from the sampling pattern)
shifts the interface level's camera and its objects by +0x280 (one screen) when the pointer reaches the right edge

kind 13 method (flag): when set, makes this object the carried item (cursor +0x12c) and switches the cursor animation to item id + 7; when cleared, drops it. Verb indices 7 and above are therefore carried inventory items

per-frame step of a scripted action list (24-byte steps at +0xbc, current step +0xcc): waits (type 1 until the speaker finishes plus 200 ms, type 2 timed), choice menus (types 5, 6: asks the player object to say the options), cursor show/hide (type 8), type 9 wait for an animation; advances or ends the list (returns 2 or 3)
